functions.name: accumulate_usage_daily
functions.identity_arguments: p_org_id text, p_subject_id text, p_provider text, p_model text, p_usage_date date, p_input_tokens bigint, p_output_tokens bigint, p_cached_input_tokens bigint, p_runs integer
functions.arguments: p_org_id text, p_subject_id text, p_provider text, p_model text, p_usage_date date, p_input_tokens bigint, p_output_tokens bigint, p_cached_input_tokens bigint, p_runs integer
functions.definition:
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO work.usage_daily AS u
    (org_id, subject_id, provider, model, usage_date,
     input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_input_tokens, run_count, revision)
  VALUES
    (p_org_id, p_subject_id, p_provider, btrim(p_model), p_usage_date,
     GREATEST(0, p_input_tokens), GREATEST(0, p_output_tokens),
     GREATEST(0, p_cached_input_tokens), GREATEST(0, p_runs), 1)
  ON CONFLICT (org_id, subject_id, provider, model, usage_date) DO UPDATE
  SET input_tokens = GREATEST(0, u.input_tokens + p_input_tokens),
      output_tokens = GREATEST(0, u.output_tokens + p_output_tokens),
      cached_input_tokens = GREATEST(0, u.cached_input_tokens + p_cached_input_tokens),
      run_count = GREATEST(0, u.run_count + p_runs),
      revision = u.revision + 1,
      updated_at = now();
END;

functions.name: claim_outbox
functions.identity_arguments: p_relay_id text, p_limit integer, p_lease_seconds integer
functions.arguments: p_relay_id text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 60
functions.definition:
BEGIN
  IF p_relay_id IS NULL OR p_relay_id !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]{2,63}$'
     OR p_lease_seconds IS NULL OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 600 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_request' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('app.outbox_relay', 'on', true);
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH picked AS (
    SELECT o.id
    FROM work.outbox o
    WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL
      AND o.dead_lettered_at IS NULL
      AND o.available_at <= now()
      AND (o.claimed_until IS NULL OR o.claimed_until < now())
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM work.outbox e
        WHERE e.aggregate_type = o.aggregate_type
          AND e.aggregate_id = o.aggregate_id
          AND e.outbox_seq < o.outbox_seq
          AND e.delivered_at IS NULL
      )
    ORDER BY o.outbox_seq
    LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_limit, 1), 100)
    FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED
  )
  UPDATE work.outbox u
  SET claimed_by = p_relay_id,
      claimed_until = now() + make_interval(secs => p_lease_seconds)
  FROM picked
  WHERE u.id = picked.id
  RETURNING u.*;
  PERFORM set_config('app.outbox_relay', 'off', true);
END;

views.name: task_summary
views.definition:
SELECT t.org_id,
    t.id AS task_id,
    t.owner_subject_id,
    t.title,
    t.state AS task_state,
    t.permission_mode,
    t.active_run_id,
    t.latest_run_id,
    t.revision,
    t.created_at,
    t.updated_at,
    r.state AS run_state,
    r.wait_reason,
    r.terminal_reason,
    a.id AS latest_artifact_id,
    av.version_no AS latest_artifact_version,
    av.content_hash AS latest_artifact_hash,
    t.state = 'awaiting_acceptance'::text AS pending_acceptance,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM work.operation o
          WHERE o.run_id = r.id AND o.org_id = t.org_id AND (o.state = ANY (ARRAY['prepared'::text, 'waiting_approval'::text, 'authorized'::text, 'dispatching'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'unresolved'::text]))), 0::bigint) AS blocking_operations,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(br.amount_tokens) AS sum
           FROM work.quota_reservation br
             JOIN work.operation o ON o.id = br.operation_id AND o.org_id = br.org_id
          WHERE (o.run_id IN ( SELECT rr.id
                   FROM work.run rr
                  WHERE rr.task_id = t.id AND rr.org_id = t.org_id)) AND (br.state = ANY (ARRAY['held'::text, 'unknown'::text]))), 0::numeric) AS reserved_tokens,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(be.amount_tokens) AS sum
           FROM work.quota_entry be
             JOIN work.operation o ON o.id = be.operation_id AND o.org_id = be.org_id
          WHERE (o.run_id IN ( SELECT rr.id
                   FROM work.run rr
                  WHERE rr.task_id = t.id AND rr.org_id = t.org_id)) AND (be.kind = ANY (ARRAY['settle'::text, 'adjust'::text]))), 0::numeric) AS settled_tokens,
        CASE
            WHEN t.state = 'completed'::text THEN 'completed'::text
            WHEN t.state = 'canceled'::text THEN 'canceled'::text
            WHEN t.state = 'archived'::text THEN 'archived'::text
            WHEN t.state = 'awaiting_acceptance'::text THEN 'awaiting_acceptance'::text
            WHEN r.state = 'queued'::text THEN 'queued'::text
            WHEN r.state = 'cancel_requested'::text THEN 'canceling'::text
            WHEN (r.state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'waiting'::text])) AND r.wait_reason = 'quota'::text THEN 'quota_exhausted'::text
            WHEN (r.state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'waiting'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM work.operation o
              WHERE o.run_id = r.id AND o.org_id = t.org_id AND (o.state = ANY (ARRAY['unknown'::text, 'unresolved'::text])))) THEN 'reconciling'::text
            WHEN r.state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'waiting'::text]) THEN 'running'::text
            WHEN r.state = 'canceled'::text THEN 'run_canceled'::text
            WHEN r.state = 'failed'::text THEN 'failed'::text
            ELSE 'open'::text
        END AS display_state
   FROM work.task t
     LEFT JOIN work.run r ON r.id = t.latest_run_id AND r.org_id = t.org_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ar.id
           FROM work.artifact ar
          WHERE ar.task_id = t.id AND ar.org_id = t.org_id AND ar.state = 'published'::text
          ORDER BY ar.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) a ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.version_no,
            v.content_hash
           FROM work.artifact_version v
          WHERE v.artifact_id = a.id AND v.org_id = t.org_id AND v.state = 'published'::text
          ORDER BY v.version_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) av ON true
  WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL;
